summary: No actionable defects found; the email input now resets fallback UI and the regression test covers the password-only to passkey-only switch.

evidence: public/auth.js lines 112-126: the email input handler resets canRetryPasskey, hides and clears password and confirmation fields, clears status, and refreshes busy state when passkey fallback password is shown.

tests/bun_test.ts lines 300-481: the regression test submits a password-only email with no_credentials, edits to a passkey-only email, asserts the retry control and hidden password, then completes passkey login in the same page session.
